args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r08, check_failed_but_accepted. Closure is 2.899 against a limit of 1.0, so the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tracked kinematics. The record marks this check as passed. The run uses the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run and no other check backs up its strain-rate profile.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r07. All checks pass. Their large |z| values come from a near-zero batch MAD. The REGR peak in r01, r02 and r06 is 53.24 vs 53.1 %/h, and r03's growth zone is 674 vs 684 µm. Peak position (421 µm) and flank-difference position (84 µm) match the batch.
Common to the flagged run: one run only, a tip-motion closure mismatch accepted under the width-free ratio. Its velocity and strain-rate summaries are in line with the batch. The closure check's pass/fail field should be fixed upstream.
